result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d strengthen humanity’s capacity for genuine empathy—the ability to truly understand and care about one another’s experiences, even across deep differences.

So much conflict, inequality, and suffering seems to grow from an inability or unwillingness to see others as fully real, complex, and worthy of dignity. If people could more consistently feel the weight of others’ joy and pain, many other problems—war, cruelty, exploitation, neglect—would become harder to justify and easier to solve.
